text: For 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-22 we project 56 to 56 orders, most likely about 56. This is an estimate from your recent weeks, not a forecast. It uses your last 8 weeks (trend +1.01 a week) and a context factor of 1.015 from india_festivals. Demand windows in that period: Diwali (Deepavali) (2026-11-01 to 2026-11-08). Demand is about 98 orders (82 to 115), more than the 56 you can make at 14 a week. Demand is expected to exceed what you can make: about 42 orders would be turned away. Capacity is what limits these weeks: plan batches or pre-orders now.
